scope: Incident occurrence year 2010-2024, raw SYSTEM_PART_INVOLVED MAIN or MAIN VALVE, raw material CAST/WROUGHT IRON / STEEL / PLASTIC; n=693, k=141
primary_age: incident occurrence year minus structured INSTALLATION_YEAR; no inferred era/manufacture substitution
complete_case_rules: Finite age>=0, diameter>0, normal pressure>=0; explicit zero pressure retained; no imputation
split: early: report received year<=2021; later: received year>=2022 within the same occurrence-year scope; never select on later labels
preprocessing: log1p diameter and pressure; StandardScaler fitted on early complete records only
algorithm: KMeans k=2..8; n_init=50, max_iter=500, algorithm=lloyd, seed=20261109
selection: maximum early average silhouette; exact tie chooses smaller k. All candidate sizes retained; no outcome or material/cause labels enter selection.
later_assignment: nearest frozen early standardized centroid; no later fit
baseline_checks: Material and age-bin agreement after grouping; original-unit profiles; full 693 vs complete-record selection differences
sensitivity: One separately documented narrative installation-year recovery may be assessed after the primary result; no silent change to structured age.
